steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're going to let them use us for nothing?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's gonna happen if they really start calling themselves Reunion?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: They definitely will.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We'll be hunted down.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A town of this size can't do anything to us. But... What if it was an entire nomadic city?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If we took just one of the big Leithanian bankers, musicians, or aristocrats out of their fancy towers, we'd be set for life.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Pride will ruin them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's the same pride that keeps Leithanien's aggressive streak in check.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We should avoid making trouble in Wolumonde. We will have nowhere else to go.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We should not meet on the battlefield. This... this is no battlefield. Is it?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You, all of you, your time grows short.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Um...? Who are you talking to?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Just... musing.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Winter is coming. And we will have no choice.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Ugh... I've got a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Now, any more questions?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Just to be sure, how did you identify the eight corpses, Officer Severin?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Body type, sex, approximate age, a list of the town's missing persons.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But now is not the time to discuss the fire. We have more pressing issues at hand.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I don't disagree, but...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What have you got?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: The number of Infected people who lost their lives in the fire was 'four,' according to the Reunion member we spoke to.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Is there a reason we should care what the enemy has to say?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: With all due respect, this does matter. 'Caring' what he says is different from 'trusting' it. We have a major risk of misunderstanding here.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I still don't think this will solve the problem. Uncovering the truth about the fire will not improve our situation.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It means a lot to me.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Then, with all due respect, Miss Folinic, you've been letting your emotions pull you around too much.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But you must—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I fight for Wolumonde and Wolumonde alone. That is my duty. I'm not here to serve the justice in your heart.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I have a responsibility to give the truth to Rhodes Island, not your thirst for revenge.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —No, you're right...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I need to go calm down... I, I'll go help Lisa with the wounded.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Then it's settled. Our top priority is to retake Zwölftontechnik Strasse.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: War is inevitable, at this point. Rhodes Island will need to focus on the fight for the automated Arts units, all while keeping a close eye on the Sarkaz and other partisans.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Direct crowd control will be on us. The most difficult jobs, we give to you.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Erm, did I say too much?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No. Tell me, what did you see in their eyes? The insurgents, and the angry townspeople.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: If they managed to overwhelm us, that would be the end of the town of Wolumonde.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: And regardless of what the truth may be, headlines around the world would read 'Reunion resurfaces and destroys a town in Leithanien.'

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: After so many sacrifices, so many goodbyes, I did not want to see it happen again.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Ayerscarpe, contact Click. It's time to regroup.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm going to check on the Infected captives.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz? I saw Miss Folinic already left. Is the meeting over?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes. Thank you.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're getting loud out there.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They think they can destroy our homes and get away with it?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They trashed my shop, and beat my children!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Those damned traitors! Ingrates! After all we gave them!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: We have to fight back!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Fight back! Fight back! Fight back!
Fight back! Fight back! Fight back!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ugh. Look at them. Every one of them an avatar of justice.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Uncle, you really shouldn't smoke...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Doesn't matter.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Okay, all better!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That being said, you still have a mild infection. So don't go abusing Originium Arts!

steps.name: Infected Captive
steps.text: Is that a joke? I'm a Leithanian. An educated Leithanian. How could I—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No fighting!

steps.name: Infected Captive
steps.text: No, it's not about fighting. Without Arts, I can't even use my refrigerator!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You just use it normally, through the device. Don't irritate the Originium in your body. That way, you don't worsen your infection!

steps.name: Infected Captive
steps.text: ...I cheaped out and bought a second-hand one that needs a caster to operate...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Infected Captive
steps.text: Y-you're an outsider! What do you know? Will I ever get to lead a normal life? With what we're fighting against, we—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Okay, okay. Just remember to take care of yourself so you don't get worse. You're still pretty healthy. And no more using Arts!

steps.name: Infected Captive
steps.text: We're fighting against... Never mind. What can I say to a child...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: All right. Next up...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh, an old man? What's he doing here at his age...?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Heh heh. A nine-tailed Vulpo. That's something you don't see every day.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hm. That reminds me. I've been hearing a lot of talk of Winterwisps and outlanders. Would that be you?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh, yes. Can you tell me where you're hurt?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hm? Oh, I'm not hurt. I'm just here to wait for death. I'm old, and getting sleepy...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: D-death? Let's not get too morbid here...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Child, I'm a Winterwisp. Last of the Winterwisp clansmen, in fact.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Heh heh. You're awfully cute when you're shocked, child... And, I sense no hostility from you.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: The last...? But everyone's been saying the Winterwisps are helping the Infected rebels.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: *Sigh*. It's only when they're so filled with hate that they think of their heritage. And that heritage is just an excuse. They hate something else altogether.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Would you indulge an old man for a minute? I'm already your prisoner, after all. I'm not going to do anything... ever again. I'm too old.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh, um... As old as you are, I should treat you. Even if it's just a flesh wound.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hah hah. I'm still pretty strong, in my old age... No, no. That's a lie.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: My clansmen mostly went elsewhere. Or they intermarried with the people of Wolumonde.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: In the end, how many real Winterwisps are left? Just a few of us old fogies.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sir... what did you do?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: I... killed. Many people.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: A traveling merchant who came to Wolumonde, a noble who dared to wander into the wilds... and so many more.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: At first we thought it was justified. Proper vengeance...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: So the old-timers did all the hard work. The younger ones just stood by. None of it meant anything to their lives anymore.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: But vengeance. We couldn't kill the traitors. We couldn't kill the rotten nobles. It turns out, we could only unleash our hatred on so many innocents.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: We couldn't defeat Leithanien. Not its laws, not the mighty roar of the engines of its nomadic cities.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: We started giving up. I escaped into Wolumonde, and Severin picked off the other old clansmen one by one. He's a hunter. Never wavers.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: But they say he'll sit with a dying enemy and have one last smoke with him. Too bad today's manufactured cigarettes are awful.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: As for me, I built myself a nest out of scavenged tin, underneath Wolumonde. Severin didn't get the last one, in the end.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Am I afraid to die? Nay. Believe me, little Vulpo girl, I'm not afraid.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: I just want to hear the sound of a town's power plant roaring to life, after my own lifetime of fruitless revenge.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Maybe someday Wolumonde will grow into a nomadic city, or maybe it'll die out.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: But... Hah... I'm a Winterwisp. Was I furious the first time I saw that boiler heat up and send the town crawling away? Yes, but what could I do? I remember it. I just cried.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: It surged, it scorched, it singed, unstoppable. What could I do with only my bow and a short sword? I fell in love with it... with this murder weapon...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: But Biederman did it, treacherous boy. A Catastrophe Messenger, and an outsider, did what I'd never dare to do in my entire life...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: S-slow down, sir! Th-that Biederman you're talking about...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I remember a Catastrophe Messenger in Leithanien by that name, but I think he died in the fire?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hm? I'm not sure about that. He's the one giving the orders.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: So that means...?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Do you know that feeling of powerlessness?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: When I watched Biederman... take the Infected, the Arts, the destruction... When I watched him ruin the power plant, I was completely powerless...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: It turns out the thing that conquered us all those years ago was just a big hunk of iron... How weary I've become.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: ...Are you still there?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes, I'm listening.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Don't rush to revenge. Don't fight. Listen to me, girl.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: The Winterwisps aren't the reason for all this... At least, not anymore.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: How many here in Wolumonde have the Winterwisp blood in their veins? We were the ones who built this place in the beginning.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Winterwisp, Winterwisp is Wolumonde... It's the moon... And they, they destroyed themselves...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: So that's the story.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Look, little Vulpo girl, do you see where the road leads?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Up ahead? It's an ordinary road. It leads to the town hall.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: It leads to the mountains.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: The long banner flies... twelve twists and turns in the trail... travelers and blowing snow... ah... the power plant...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Right. I forgot.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That is the way to the mountains.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Good night.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Did you hear that, Folinic?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: We've been going in circles.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A Catastrophe Messenger thought dead is actually leading the mob?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Biederman, huh...?
Mmm——♪ Mmmhmm——♪
Such a brittle little branch♪
Winterwisp, oh, Winterwisp♪
Weary of a long life, weary of a long death♪
Sing out your song, firm and strong~♪
Singing through summer~♪
And on through winter~♪
Winterwisp, oh, Winterwisp~♪
